Foundation Training v2 · adaptive selective learning

Off. Standard joint learning remains available.

Each candidate starts with identical complete weights and optimizer state. The trainer compares true held-out validation, autonomous replies, and earlier-skill retention, keeping only an eligible whole checkpoint. Direct TXT training retains the original five-session limit. ZIP teaching lets you choose the first five lessons or the entire archive, with up to three adaptive retries for each selective lesson. Retries test a smaller learning rate, a different example schedule with extra epochs, then both together. Practice fit and novel held-out answers are reported separately; acceptance still protects earlier skills. Rehearsal and previous-skill protection must be enabled. Android training can take much longer.

Saved teacher tests can protect exact greedy responses during checkpoint selection. Answers never enter neural inference.

Validation uses held-out question groups; the trainer keeps the best joint checkpoint and may stop if validation stalls. Earlier independent checkpoints remain untouched. Validation is not proof of understanding.

Bulk lessons · sequential ZIP teaching

Import a ZIP with numbered .txt lessons. Structured TXT files identify their own Dialogue, Understanding, Conversation and Reasoning blocks; choose a legacy type above only for older unstructured files. Each file gets its own training run, holdouts, and checkpoint selection. Files are ordered by their names (01_, 02_, 03_). Existing model state is preserved between lessons.

Foundation v2 retries a rejected lesson up to three times: lower learning rate, alternate example scheduling with six extra epochs, then both together. Each attempt is compared with the protected accepted brain. A failed lesson is only skipped after retries are exhausted; sampled practice-fit and held-out-generalization evidence appear below.

FOUNDATION LEARNING · EXPERIMENTAL TEACHER MODE

Targeted Training

One neural mind · Selectable gradient updates · Protected checkpoint

Teach a neural pathway or Nova's trainable two-way interconnect while the rest of the original brain still participates in forward and backward computation. Targeting controls which weights can change, not which hemisphere is allowed to reason. Nothing touches live Nova until you accept a whole candidate checkpoint.

Choose a starting brain and learning focus

No imported checkpoint staged. An imported brain does not replace live Nova.

The selected region changes through actual neural gradients. The context objective uses Understanding Lesson examples, not a hidden symbolic knowledge base.

Selected objective must have independent held-out examples

Examples use your existing unified Dialogue, Understanding, Multi-Turn and Reasoning blocks. Training filters to the selected objective without turning instructional prose into scripted answers. The dense network still has its current 64-character input limitation.

An accepted candidate is a complete trained brain, not an arbitrary splice of individual neurons.

Manual acceptance creates a backup of the active checkpoint and installs the entire focused-trained neural brain. A stale candidate is rejected if active weights changed in the meantime. Imported candidates retain their own tokenizer and optimizer; chat history is cleared on acceptance. Until then, live Nova is untouched.
